title: Hell doesn’t need you to fall… it only needs you to hesitate.
paragraphs:
Hell doesn’t need you to fall… it only needs you to hesitate.
Every delayed act of obedience becomes a celebration in the darkness.
Choose now. Step now. Obey now. Heaven moves when you do.

📖 BIBLE VERSE
James 4:17 (ESV)
“So whoever knows the right thing to do and fails to do it, for him it is sin.”
